erp.current_app_role():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.current_app_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select r.role_code
  from erp.app_users u
  join erp.app_roles r on r.id=u.role_id
  where u.auth_user_id=auth.uid() and u.is_active and r.is_active
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erp_save_app_user_v3(p_payload jsonb, p_client_request_id uuid, p_expected_version bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin return erp.save_app_user_v2(p_payload,p_client_request_id,p_expected_version); end $function$
p_payload jsonb, p_client_request_id uuid, p_expected_version bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint
erp._idempotency_actor_key():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp._idempotency_actor_key()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'erp', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    erp.current_app_user_id()::text,
    auth.uid()::text,
    'database:' || session_user
  )
$function$
